name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 04-diff-check.sh
command: bash -c git diff --check; echo "diff-check exit=$?"; git status --short | head -n 30; git diff -- .gitignore > docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1c-r2/delivery.diff; echo "---DELIVERY.DIFF---"; cat docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1c-r2/delivery.diff

name: 05-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1c-r2\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"

name: 03-math-frozen.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import hashlib, math
print("---KÖ-1 reverify---")
p = 2 * math.comb(30, 30) / 2**30
print("p = %.15e" % p)
assert abs(p - 1.862645149230957e-09) < 1e-21
print("KÖ-1 MATCH")
print("---KÖ-3 reverify---")
p1 = [math.comb(16, k) * 0.25**k * 0.75**(16 - k) for k in range(17)]
p2 = [math.comb(14, j) * 0.125**j * 0.875**(14 - j) for j in range(15)]
E = 16 * 0.25 + 14 * 0.125
tail = sum(a * b for k, a in enumerate(p1) for j, b in enumerate(p2) if k + j >= 6)
print("E = %.2f / P = %.10f" % (E, tail))
assert E == 5.75 and abs(tail - 0.5281675) < 5e-8
print("KÖ-3 MATCH")
PY
echo "---FROZEN---"
python3 -c "import json,hashlib; man=json.load(open(\"results/dataset_audit/phase7e_preregistration_hash.json\")); lines=[f\"{p}:{hashlib.sha256(open(p,\"rb\").read()).hexdigest()}\" for p in sorted(man[\"protocol_files\"])]; comp=hashlib.sha256((chr(10).join(lines)).encode()).hexdigest(); print(\"composite:\",comp,\"match:\",comp==man[\"composite_protocol_hash\"])"; sha256sum dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json; python3 -c "import hashlib; [print(f, len(open(f).read().splitlines()), hashlib.sha256(open(f,\"rb\").read()).hexdigest()) for f in [\"results/dataset_audit/phase7e_review_history.jsonl\",\"results/dataset_audit/phase7g_review_history.jsonl\"]]"
echo "---PRIORS-UNTOUCHED---"
python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok = True
for pkg in ["E1c", "E1c-r1"]:
    n = 0
    for line in open(f"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/{pkg}/run-outputs.sha256"):
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2: continue
        exp, path = parts
        if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256") or "run-outputs.sh.stdout" in path: continue
        got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        n += 1
        if got != exp:
            ok = False; print("MODIFIED", path)
    print(pkg, f"{n} files checked")
print("PRIORS-UNTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY
echo "---BRIEF-COVERAGE---"
python3 - <<PY
t = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1c-r2/estimand-contract.md", encoding="utf-8").read() + open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1c-r2/revision-map.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
for term in ["resolved_response_rating", "3 endpoint", "contested", "D-A", "error-asymmetry", "pending", "uncertain", "partial", "stratified_by_assistant_stance", "havuz", "APPROVED"]:
    print(("OK " if term in t else "MISSING ") + term)
PY
